notes.title: The Fat Mask Soundtrack is available NOW!
notes.notes:
In celebration of the launch of Fat Mask next MONDAY (May 15th), you can now get the Fat Mask OST masterly composed by non-other than the great composer Antoine Vachon. 

Get it now on [b]Bancamp![/b]

[url]https://antoinevachon.bandcamp.com/album/fat-mask-original-soundtrack[/url]

notes.title: Fat Mask will officially launch May 15th!
notes.notes:
Fat Mask will officially be available worldwide next [b]Monday, May 15th at 10 AM (Eastern Time) (7 AM PST)! [/b]

Price will be [b]$9.99 USD with 10% off[/b] for the first week of release! Get it while it still hot!

(Note: Prices will vary depending on your region and currency)
